{
  "subtype": "causal_attribution",
  "outcome_variable": "hardware_incident_spike",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "incident_category", "causal_role": "confounder", "named_in_query": true, "rationale": "Identifies hardware vs other categories; needed to define/filter the outcome group. It is more a stratifier of the outcome (hardware is named in query) than a surfaced common cause; largely descriptive of the outcome itself."},
    {"name": "failure_mode", "causal_role": "treatment", "named_in_query": false, "rationale": "Describes the mechanism of failure (overheating, not_powering_on, physical_damage). Could serve as a candidate cause of hardware incidents; surfaced from text and plausibly explanatory of the spike."},
    {"name": "incident_action_type", "causal_role": "mediator", "named_in_query": false, "rationale": "break_fix/installation etc. is a downstream response to the incident, on the path after the incident occurs, not a common cause of both a cause and the outcome."},
    {"name": "affected_asset_scope", "causal_role": "confounder", "named_in_query": false, "rationale": "server_infrastructure vs end_user_device etc. plausibly affects both the failure mode (treatment) and the propensity to generate hardware incidents; surfaced from data, a candidate common cause."},
    {"name": "software_update_trigger", "causal_role": "treatment", "named_in_query": false, "rationale": "A boolean candidate cause: whether a software update/patch triggered the incident. Timing of updates could drive the spike; a genuine attributable treatment surfaced from data."},
    {"name": "recurrence_signal", "causal_role": "collider", "named_in_query": false, "rationale": "Whether the incident recurs is a consequence of the incident, not a prior common cause; conditioning on it risks selection bias rather than confounding control."},
    {"name": "is_repeat_caller", "causal_role": "confounder", "named_in_query": false, "rationale": "Repeat callers may both experience more failures and be more likely to log incidents, plausibly a common cause of reporting propensity and observed incident counts; surfaced from data."}
  ],
  "treatment_present": true,
  "treatment_columns": ["failure_mode", "software_update_trigger"],
  "confounders": [
    {"name": "affected_asset_scope", "named_in_query": false, "plausibility": 0.55},
    {"name": "is_repeat_caller", "named_in_query": false, "plausibility": 0.45}
  ],
  "confounder_quality": 0.4,
  "rationale": "The set supplies plausible treatments (software_update_trigger as a candidate cause, failure_mode as mechanism), satisfying part (a). For part (b), a couple of surfaced variables (affected_asset_scope, is_repeat_caller) could act as common causes and were not named in the query, showing some genuine confounder discovery. However several columns are mediators (incident_action_type) or colliders (recurrence_signal) mislabelled as explanatory, incident_category largely restates the outcome definition, and no confounder is a clearly strong common cause of both a specific treatment and the outcome. The causal estimation is only weakly set up, so confounder quality is moderate-to-low."
}
